bash.name: SHIELD BASH
bash.desc: SLAM YOUR SHIELD INTO A FOE: DAMAGE, KNOCKBACK AND A 1S STUN.

taunt.name: TAUNT
taunt.desc: EVERY ENEMY NEARBY ATTACKS BRANN FOR 4S. HE TAKES HALF DAMAGE MEANWHILE.

charge.name: CHARGE
charge.desc: DASH TO A FOE, KNOCKING ASIDE EVERYTHING IN THE WAY.

shieldwall.name: SHIELD WALL
shieldwall.desc: BLOCK 80% OF DAMAGE FOR 3S AND REFLECT ARROWS.

earthsplitter.name: EARTHSPLITTER
earthsplitter.desc: SLAM A LINE OF SHOCKWAVES AHEAD THAT STAGGERS FOES.

retribution.name: RETRIBUTION
retribution.desc: TAKING A HIT CUTS SHIELD BASH'S COOLDOWN BY 0.5S.

laststand.name: LAST STAND
laststand.desc: ONCE PER FIGHT, A LETHAL HIT LEAVES YOU AT 1 HP, INVULNERABLE FOR 3S.

bulwark.name: BULWARK
bulwark.desc: SHIELDS THE WHOLE PARTY AND TAUNTS EVERYTHING NEARBY.
bulwark.upgrade: L20 TOME: WHEN THE SHIELD ENDS IT BURSTS, HEALING THE PARTY 15%.

fireball.name: FIREBALL
fireball.desc: A BOLT THAT BURSTS IN A SMALL AREA AND BURNS.

frostnova.name: FROST NOVA
frostnova.desc: A RING OF FROST AROUND PIP: DAMAGE AND 2 CHILL STACKS.

chain.name: CHAIN LIGHTNING
chain.desc: LIGHTNING THAT JUMPS BETWEEN UP TO 4 FOES.

blink.name: BLINK
blink.desc: TELEPORT AWAY FROM DANGER, LEAVING A DECOY FOR 2S.

barrage.name: ARCANE BARRAGE
barrage.desc: SIX HOMING MISSILES SPREAD ACROSS NEARBY FOES.

surge.name: ELEMENTAL SURGE
surge.desc: FOR 6S EVERY SPELL BURNS, CHILLS AND SHOCKS.

attunement.name: ATTUNEMENT
attunement.desc: STATUSES PIP APPLIES LAST 50% LONGER (+10% PER RANK).

studious.name: STUDIOUS
studious.desc: SPELL CRITS CUT 1S OFF YOUR LONGEST COOLDOWN (ONCE A SECOND).

wardweave.name: WARDWEAVE
wardweave.desc: -20% DAMAGE TAKEN FROM ARROWS AND SPELLS.

meteor.name: METEOR
meteor.desc: CALLS DOWN A METEOR ON A CLUSTER OF FOES.
meteor.upgrade: L20 TOME: LEAVES BURNING GROUND FOR 5S.

step.name: SHADOW STEP
step.desc: MELT INTO SHADOW, REAPPEAR BEHIND A FOE AND BACKSTAB IT. ALWAYS CRITS.

fan.name: FAN OF KNIVES
fan.desc: A RING OF THROWN BLADES AROUND SABLE.

smoke.name: SMOKE BOMB
smoke.desc: FOES IN THE CLOUD MISS HALF THEIR ATTACKS. SABLE VANISHES FOR 2S.

riposte.name: RIPOSTE
riposte.desc: PARRY THE NEXT HIT WITHIN 0.6S AND COUNTER WITH A GUARANTEED CRIT.

deathmark.name: DEATH MARK
deathmark.desc: MARKED FOE TAKES +25% FROM THE PARTY. IF IT DIES, THE COOLDOWN RESETS.

quickhands.name: QUICK HANDS
quickhands.desc: CRITS TAKE 0.3S OFF ALL COOLDOWNS (ONCE A SECOND).

lightfingers.name: LIGHT FINGERS
lightfingers.desc: 15% CHANCE OF BONUS GOLD THE FIRST TIME YOU HIT A FOE.

thousand_cuts.name: THOUSAND CUTS
thousand_cuts.desc: STREAKS BETWEEN UP TO FIVE FOES, CRITTING EACH.
thousand_cuts.upgrade: L20 TOME: UP TO 8 FOES, AND IT RECASTS FREE IF THE LAST ONE FALLS.

mend.name: MEND
mend.desc: HEALS NEARBY ALLIES AND REVIVES THE DOWNED. (CLERIC DISCIPLINE)

powershot.name: POWER SHOT
powershot.desc: A HEAVY ARROW THAT PIERCES EVERY FOE IN A LINE.

hawkstrike.name: HAWK STRIKE
hawkstrike.desc: KESTREL DIVES ON A FOE AND MARKS IT: +10% DAMAGE TAKEN FOR 6S. REVEALS HIDDEN FOES.

volley.name: VOLLEY
volley.desc: ARROWS RAIN ON AN AREA FOR 2S.

snare.name: SNARE TRAP
snare.desc: SETS A TRAP THAT ROOTS THE FIRST FOE TO STEP ON IT FOR 3S.

disengage.name: DISENGAGE
disengage.desc: BACKFLIP AWAY AND LOOSE A SHOT THAT SLOWS.

blastarrow.name: BLAST ARROW
blastarrow.desc: A FIRE ARROW THAT EXPLODES ON IMPACT.

hawksight.name: HAWK SIGHT
hawksight.desc: OUT OF COMBAT, KESTREL PINGS NEARBY CHESTS AND GOLDEN FLIES ON THE MINIMAP.

talons.name: STORM OF TALONS
talons.desc: FOR 4S KESTREL AND A RAIN OF ARROWS STRIKE EVERY FOE NEARBY.
talons.upgrade: L20 TOME: LASTS 8S, AND EVERY HIT STUNS.

cleave.name: CLEAVE
cleave.desc: A WIDE SWING THAT HITS EVERY FOE IN FRONT.

leap.name: LEAP
leap.desc: JUMP ONTO A FOE AND SLAM THE GROUND AROUND IT.

howl.name: HOWL
howl.desc: NEARBY FOES (NOT BOSSES) FLEE IN FEAR FOR 2S.

rend.name: REND
rend.desc: A RAKING BLOW THAT LEAVES A STACKING BLEED.

whirlwind.name: WHIRLWIND
whirlwind.desc: SPIN WITH BOTH AXES FOR 3S, HITTING EVERYTHING AROUND YOU.

rage.name: RAGE
rage.desc: DEALS MORE DAMAGE AS HP DROPS, UP TO +40%.

thickhide.name: THICK HIDE
thickhide.desc: REGENERATE 1% HP/S OUT OF COMBAT, 0.3%/S IN COMBAT.

beastsense.name: BEAST SENSE
beastsense.desc: HIDDEN AND SUBMERGED FOES ARE REVEALED NEAR KESH.

primal.name: PRIMAL FORM
primal.desc: FOR 8S: +50% DAMAGE, 20% LIFESTEAL, IMMUNE TO STUN AND SLOW.
primal.upgrade: L20 TOME: LASTS 12S, AND EVERY HIT SLAMS THE GROUND.

sweep.name: SWEEPING STRIKE
sweep.desc: A FULL-CIRCLE SLASH THAT HITS AND KNOCKS BACK EVERY FOE AROUND YOU. (BLADE)

guardparry.name: PARRY
guardparry.desc: BRACE FOR 0.8S: THE NEXT MELEE HIT IS TURNED ASIDE AND COUNTERED. (BLADE)

shadedash.name: SHADE DASH
shadedash.desc: DASH THROUGH A LINE OF FOES AS A SHADOW, CUTTING EACH ONE. YOU CANNOT BE HIT MID-DASH. (SHADOW)

poisoncloud.name: POISON CLOUD
poisoncloud.desc: A CLOUD OF VENOM ON A FOE: POISONS EVERYTHING INSIDE FOR 4S. (SHADOW)

quickshot.name: QUICK SHOT
quickshot.desc: A FAST SHOT AT A FOE IN RANGE. ANY HERO CAN LOOSE ONE, EVEN WITH A SWORD IN HAND. (RANGER)

tripwire.name: SNARE
tripwire.desc: LAYS A SNARE AT YOUR FEET THAT ROOTS THE FIRST FOE TO STEP ON IT FOR 2S. (RANGER)

clericward.name: WARD
clericward.desc: SHIELDS THE MOST HURT ALLY FOR 25% OF THEIR HEALTH FOR 6S. (CLERIC)

oheal.name: HEAL
oheal.desc: A LARGE HEAL ON THE MOST HURT ALLY.

smite.name: SMITE
smite.desc: A BOLT OF RADIANT LIGHT STRIKES A FOE. UNDEAD AND HEXED FOES TAKE MORE.

sanctuary.name: SANCTUARY
sanctuary.desc: A CIRCLE OF LIGHT THAT HEALS ALLIES STANDING IN IT FOR 6S.

purify.name: PURIFY
purify.desc: CLEARS POISON, BURNING AND SLOWS FROM THE PARTY AND BLOCKS NEW ONES FOR 3S.

halo.name: HALO
halo.desc: SHIELDS THE MOST HURT ALLY FOR 20% OF THEIR HEALTH.

judgment.name: JUDGMENT
judgment.desc: A PILLAR OF LIGHT FALLS ON A FOE: HEAVY RADIANT DAMAGE AROUND IT, AND UNDEAD OR HEXED FOES ARE STUNNED.

optimism.name: OPTIMISM
optimism.desc: OVERHEALING BECOMES A SHIELD, UP TO 15% OF MAX HP.

steadyhands.name: STEADY HANDS
steadyhands.desc: OAKE REVIVES FALLEN ALLIES TWICE AS FAST.

faith.name: FAITH
faith.desc: 10% OF THE LIGHT DAMAGE OAKE DEALS HEALS THE PARTY.

dawnbreak.name: DAWNBREAK
dawnbreak.desc: REVIVES EVERY FALLEN ALLY AND HEALS THE PARTY TO FULL OVER 3S.
dawnbreak.upgrade: L20 TOME: ALSO BLASTS NEARBY FOES WITH LIGHT.

turret.name: DEPLOY TURRET
turret.desc: DROPS A TURRET THAT SHOOTS NEARBY FOES FOR 12S. ONE AT A TIME.

sparkmine.name: SPARK MINE
sparkmine.desc: LAYS A STORM MINE: THE FIRST FOE ON IT IS SHOCKED AND STUNNED FOR 1.5S.

repairbot.name: REPAIR BOT
repairbot.desc: A LITTLE BOT THAT HEALS ALLIES NEAR IT FOR 8S.

gravity.name: GRAVITY GADGET
gravity.desc: PULLS NEARBY FOES TOGETHER INTO A CLUSTER.

rocketboots.name: ROCKET BOOTS
rocketboots.desc: A ROCKET DASH THAT LEAVES A TRAIL OF FIRE.

overcharge.name: OVERCHARGE
overcharge.desc: FOR 5S GIZMO'S GADGETS WORK TWICE AS FAST AND SHOCK WHAT THEY HIT.

engineering.name: ENGINEERING
engineering.desc: ONE MORE TURRET CAN BE OUT AT ONCE.

scrapper.name: SCRAP COLLECTOR
scrapper.desc: +50% GOBLIN SCRAP FROM FOES AND SALVAGE.

tinkersluck.name: TINKER'S LUCK
tinkersluck.desc: A 20% CHANCE TO MAKE DOUBLE WHEN CRAFTING.

clank.name: CLANK
clank.desc: SUMMONS CLANK, A MECH THAT TAUNTS AND SLAMS FOES FOR 12S.
clank.upgrade: L20 TOME: CLANK STAYS 24S AND FIRES ROCKETS.

arcmissile.name: MAGIC MISSILE
arcmissile.desc: THREE SEEKING BOLTS AT A FOE. THEY CURVE AROUND, BUT THEY ALWAYS ARRIVE. (ARCANE)

phasestep.name: BLINK STEP
phasestep.desc: VANISH AND REAPPEAR A FEW STEPS AWAY FROM DANGER, UNTOUCHABLE FOR A MOMENT. (ARCANE)

clarity.name: CLARITY
clarity.desc: -10% SKILL COOLDOWNS (-2% PER RANK). COOLDOWNS STILL CAP AT -30%. (ARCANE)

guardup.name: GUARD UP
guardup.desc: RAISES A SHIELD THAT SOAKS 25% OF MAX HP (+5% PER RANK) FOR 6S. (GUARDIAN)

provoke.name: PROVOKE
provoke.desc: A CHALLENGE THAT TURNS NEARBY FOES ON YOU FOR 3S, AND YOU TAKE 20% LESS DAMAGE WHILE THEY COME. (GUARDIAN)

stalwart.name: STALWART
stalwart.desc: +10% DEFENCE (+3% PER RANK) AND BLOWS NEVER KNOCK YOU BACK. (GUARDIAN)

iceshard.name: ICE SHARD
iceshard.desc: A SHARD OF ICE THAT PIERCES EVERY FOE IN A LINE AND CHILLS THEM.

frostprison.name: FROST PRISON
frostprison.desc: ENCASES A FOE IN ICE FOR 3S (BOSSES ARE HEAVILY CHILLED). WITH NO FOE IN REACH, IT ENCASES THE MOST HURT ALLY INSTEAD, WHO CAN'T BE HURT FOR 2S.

glacialwall.name: GLACIAL WALL
glacialwall.desc: RAISES A WALL OF ICE BETWEEN HER AND A FOE THAT BLOCKS ENEMIES AND THEIR SHOTS FOR 5S.

shatter.name: SHATTER
shatter.desc: A HEAVY BURST ON A CHILLED OR FROZEN FOE THAT USES UP THE COLD. ON ANYTHING ELSE, A LIGHT BLOW.

blizzard.name: BLIZZARD
blizzard.desc: A STORM OF SNOW OVER AN AREA FOR 4S THAT KEEPS CHILLING (AND SO FREEZING) WHAT'S IN IT.

mirrorimage.name: MIRROR IMAGE
mirrorimage.desc: TWO MIRROR COPIES OF HER STEP OUT AND CAST ICE SHARDS FOR 6S.

coldheart.name: COLD HEART
coldheart.desc: FOES SHE CHILLS ALSO DEAL 15% LESS DAMAGE.

frostbite.name: FROSTBITE
frostbite.desc: THE PARTY'S CRITS ON FROZEN FOES DO +25% (+5% PER RANK).

penance.name: PENANCE
penance.desc: WHEN AN ALLY GOES DOWN, SHE GAINS A SHIELD (20% OF MAX HP) AND HER COOLDOWNS RESET.

absolutezero.name: ABSOLUTE ZERO
absolutezero.desc: FREEZES EVERY FOE ON SCREEN FOR 3S. BOSSES ARE CHILLED TO THE BONE INSTEAD.
absolutezero.upgrade: L20 TOME: BOSSES FREEZE TOO, FOR 2S.
